text:
Noah (PM): quick sync - EnterpriseBank wants embeddings that match their on-prem vector store behavior. they asked for feature parity with their existing vendor (same vector dims + deterministic hashing). do we accept the parity asks or propose a higher-accuracy vector pipeline (longer index build, async updates) as our differentiator? need to agree on pilot scope before EOW.

Ravi (Sales): EnterpriseBank is explicit: compliance + parity are gating. they'll sign a pilot if we replicate their ops model. Pricing is flexible if we meet their checklist.

Aisha (Eng): parity mode means adding deterministic seeding, exact-dimension compatibility, and an on-disk serialization format. estimate: parity subset = 2 sprints. high-accuracy pipeline (FAISS tuning + re-encode) = 3-4 sprints. We can ship parity fast but that'll lock design choices.

Tess (Research): accuracy uplift path gives ~6-8% MRR lift on our benchmarks for retrieval tasks, but index-building latency and memory increase. For pilots we can offer a toggled mode: "compat" vs "experimental".

Elena (Security): EnterpriseBank requires FIPS-esque encryption at rest + audit trail. parity path must include KMS-wrapped keys for indexes and access logs. That's non-negotiable.

Noah (PM): proposal: offer parity compatibility for pilot (must satisfy their compliance), but brand the experimental retrieval bundle as an opt-in pilot extension. acceptance criteria for pilot: (1) deterministic hash match for sample vectors, (2) KMS-wrapped index, (3) audit events visible in console. If we pass, we get a 3-month exclusive evaluation window.

Aisha (Eng): implementation plan:
```
- sprint 1: deterministic seeding + index serialization, add KMS hook
- sprint 2: telemetry + audit events + canary to customer tenant
- opt-in sprint 3 (if agreed): experimental ranker + re-encode flow
```

DeployBot: build/emb-compatibility - all tests passing; infra provisioning staging cluster c-emb-02 queued.

Ravi (Sales): legal wants the acceptance tests spelled out in the SOW. Noah, can you write minimal acceptance checklist we can attach? also we should negotiate a short dev/devops SLA for pilot.

Noah (PM): drafting checklist now. quick draft to attach:
```
- Hash equality: 10k sample vectors match vendor baseline within 0 tolerance
- Index encryption: KMS used for all index writes
- Audit visibility: event stream available for 14 days
- Latency: p95 < 200ms for embedding lookup on pilot dataset
```

Aisha (Eng): p95 <200ms is doable in compat mode with pre-warmed Dedicated nodes. note: warm-up cost ~+15% monthly.

Elena (Security): add: key rotation policy must be documented and testable during pilot.

Tess (Research): we'll run A/B on a small eval set to compare compat vs experimental. results posted in 48h.

Noah (PM): decision: ship parity-compatible pilot with explicit opt-in experimental bundle. negotiate pilot pricing with Ravi to include credits if we fail acceptance. owners: Aisha (eng) + Elena (security) + Ravi (sales). I'll circulate SOW + checklist after thread. :rocket:

Ravi (Sales): i'll append a clause: "pilot accepts compat mode; experimental features are excluded from acceptance unless explicitly opted-in." legal to review.

Aisha (Eng): starting work on deterministic seed PR. will tag owners and add test vectors.

DeployBot: deploy/emb-compatibility -> canary started (1/3 hosts). monitoring channel: #eng-sre.

Noah (PM): thanks all. if any blocker post here. closing thread. :thumbsup:
